references.text: Another Levite who was a stranger in the hill country of Ephraim, similar situation with a Levite living as a foreigner
Bethlehem in Judah is mentioned here as Rachel's burial place, same geographical reference
Bethlehem in Judah is mentioned again in connection with a Levite
The Levites had no inheritance portion but lived in cities among the other tribes, which explains why this Levite lived as a foreigner
The Levites had no inherited share in the land; they depended on living among the other tribes
The same young Levite is recognized by the Danites, continuation of the story
The young Levite who lived with Micah, direct reference to this person
